text:
maria: starting a config-only deploy for the micro-schedule change window. small, staged: reduce max_concurrency from 60 -> 40, per-tenant weight tweak for routing, global request timeout 60s -> 45s, batch_window 12ms -> 6ms. change window: 01:30-02:15 PT. rolling canary: 1% -> 10% -> 100%. posting quick release notes link: https://go/release/2026-03-micro-schedule
release-manager: noted. please attach preflight checklist and the release notes summary in the thread. add a canary abort threshold (latency P95 +20% or errors >0.5%).
jon: will run preflight after canary 1% is up. can we pin the older routing policy as a fallback variant? if we need quick rollback, we should be able to route to policy:v1
release-manager: yep — plan: canary at 01:35, observe 10m, bump to 10% at 01:50 if good. rollback cutoff at 02:05 to give ops time. fallback: policy:v1 pinned and model-variant:stable available.
sre-ops: watch these metrics: p95_latency, requests_per_second, kv_cache_misses, gpu_mem_pressure, and 5xx_rate. set alert if 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained for 2m or p95 latency increases >20% vs baseline. also monitor tenant-specific error spikes.
maria: quick config snippet I'm deploying:```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 40,
  "timeout_s": 45,
  "batch_window_ms": 6,
  "routing_policy_weights": {"canary-policy": 1, "default": 99}
}
```
jon: lgtm. small ask — can we reduce the canary traffic distribution to be split across 3 AZs? want to avoid AZ-local skew.
deploybot: deploybot: release "micro-schedule-config-2026-03" queued by maria. steps: validate -> canary(1%) -> wait(10m) -> canary(10%) -> wait(15m) -> ramp(100%). preflight smoke test: running.
deploybot: preflight smoke: OK (token-generation, simple-generate, embed lookup)
sre-ops: good. if you see kv_cache_misses spike at canary 1% that's an early hint for cache-warmup problems. have the cache-warmup script ready (`/scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh`).
maria: noted, running warm_kv_cache before canary start.
release-manager: release notes brief: "Config-only: micro-schedule tuning to reduce tail latency and unit cost. Changes: timeout 60->45s, max_concurrency 60->40, batch_window 12->6ms, routing minor weight shift for canary. Observability: p95, 5xx, kv_cache_miss tracked. Rollback policy: automatic fallback to policy:v1 if thresholds breached." adding to central notes.
jon: if we need to rollback quickly can deploybot flip traffic to policy:v1 with `rb traffic set --policy policy:v1 --all`. keep that handy.
sre-ops: ack. also: if GPU mem pressure > 85% and p95 climbs, prefer soft-throttle (reduce batch size) before full rollback. create an ops playbook step for that.
maria: will add soft-throttle step to runbook: `set batch_window_ms 3` and `max_concurrency 30` as a middle ground.
deploybot: canary(1%) started at 01:35:10 PT. monitoring.
jon: seeing small p50 improvement, p95 stable so far. kv_cache_misses +12% but within expected warmup.
sre-ops: keep an eye on tenant X (high qps). if X shows errors, exclude them from canary with `tenant-exclude`.
deploybot: canary(1%) passed 10m guard. did not breach abort thresholds. proceeding to 10% at 01:50:05 PT.
maria: warm_kv_cache completed before 1% and again before 10%. thanks.
jon: 10% now. spot-checking logs. small uptick in backend latency for a subset — correlating with tenant Y's large batch requests.
sre-ops: temporary action: add tenant Y to exclude list for canary. issuing `tenant-exclude Y` now.
deploybot: tenant-exclude Y applied.
release-manager: decision: continue to 100% after 15m observe unless new alerts. final rollback window remains 02:05.
maria: good. setting a rollback timer and will be ready to unpin if needed.
sre-ops: reminder: if 5xx spikes, deploybot will auto-run fallback to policy:v1 after confirmation window of 30s. ensure channels #incidents and #eng-oncall are notified.
deploybot: ramp to 100% completed at 02:03:50 PT. final checks passing.
jon: monitoring post-ramp. p95 dropped ~8% from baseline, cost-per-request down slightly. no 5xx spikes.
maria: great — closing change window early at 02:10. I'll push the final release note update and tag the config commit: `cfg@a1b2c3d`.
release-manager: thanks everyone. will file the post-deploy summary tomorrow AM and mark the release as "success". :tada:
jon: thanks. updating runbook with tenant exclusion and soft-throttle steps.
sre-ops: capturing metrics snapshot and saving to perf-run/2026-03-micro-schedule.
maria: closing thread.
